mapper.select: SELECT p.post_id AS "postId",p.category AS "category",p.title AS "title",DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(p.content,260,1) AS "summary", p.medication_id AS "medicationId",p.medication_name AS "medicationName",p.review_status AS "reviewStatus", u.nickname AS "authorName",p.user_id AS "authorId",TO_CHAR(p.created_at,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "createdAt", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM community_post_helpful h WHERE h.post_id=p.post_id) AS "helpfulCount", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM community_comments c WHERE c.post_id=p.post_id AND c.status='VISIBLE') AS "commentCount", CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM community_post_helpful h WHERE h.post_id=p.post_id AND h.user_id=#{viewerId}) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "helpfulByMe" FROM community_posts p JOIN users u ON u.user_id=p.user_id ORDER BY "helpfulCount" DESC,"commentCount" DESC, p.created_at DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY

SELECT p.post_id AS "postId",p.category AS "category",p.title AS "title",DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(p.content,4000,1) AS "content",p.medication_id AS "medicationId",p.medication_name AS "medicationName", p.experience_duration AS "experienceDuration",p.age_group AS "ageGroup",p.purpose AS "purpose",p.occurrence_timing AS "occurrenceTiming",p.currently_taking AS "currentlyTaking", p.review_status AS "reviewStatus",p.status AS "status",p.user_id AS "authorId",u.nickname AS "authorName",TO_CHAR(p.created_at,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "createdAt",TO_CHAR(p.updated_at,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "updatedAt", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM community_post_helpful h WHERE h.post_id=p.post_id) AS "helpfulCount", CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM community_post_helpful h WHERE h.post_id=p.post_id AND h.user_id=#{viewerId}) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "helpfulByMe" FROM community_posts p JOIN users u ON u.user_id=p.user_id WHERE p.post_id=#{postId} AND p.status<>'DELETED'
mapper.insert: SELECT community_posts_seq.NEXTVAL FROM dual INSERT INTO community_posts(post_id,user_id,medication_id,medication_name,category,title,content,experience_duration,age_group,purpose,occurrence_timing,currently_taking,review_status,status,created_at,updated_at) VALUES(#{postId},#{userId},#{medicationId,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{medicationName,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{category},#{title},#{content},#{experienceDuration,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{ageGroup,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{purpose,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{occurrenceTiming,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{currentlyTaking},CASE WHEN #{category}='INFO_REPORT' THEN 'PENDING' ELSE 'NOT_REQUIRED' END,'VISIBLE',SYSDATE,SYSDATE)
mapper.update: UPDATE community_posts SET medication_id=#{medicationId,jdbcType=VARCHAR},medication_name=#{medicationName,jdbcType=VARCHAR},category=#{category},title=#{title},content=#{content},experience_duration=#{experienceDuration,jdbcType=VARCHAR},age_group=#{ageGroup,jdbcType=VARCHAR},purpose=#{purpose,jdbcType=VARCHAR},occurrence_timing=#{occurrenceTiming,jdbcType=VARCHAR},currently_taking=#{currentlyTaking},review_status=CASE WHEN #{category}='INFO_REPORT' THEN 'PENDING' ELSE 'NOT_REQUIRED' END,updated_at=SYSDATE WHERE post_id=#{postId} AND user_id=#{userId} AND status='VISIBLE'
UPDATE community_posts SET status='DELETED',updated_at=SYSDATE WHERE post_id=#{postId} AND user_id=#{userId} AND status<>'DELETED'
mapper.select: SELECT c.comment_id AS "commentId",c.user_id AS "authorId",u.nickname AS "authorName",DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(c.content,1000,1) AS "content",TO_CHAR(c.created_at,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "createdAt" FROM community_comments c JOIN users u ON u.user_id=c.user_id WHERE c.post_id=#{value} AND c.status='VISIBLE' ORDER BY c.created_at
mapper.insert: SELECT community_comments_seq.NEXTVAL FROM dualINSERT INTO community_comments(comment_id,post_id,user_id,content,status,created_at,updated_at) SELECT #{commentId},#{postId},#{userId},#{content},'VISIBLE',SYSDATE,SYSDATE FROM dual WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM community_posts WHERE post_id=#{postId} AND status='VISIBLE')
mapper.update: UPDATE community_comments SET status='DELETED',updated_at=SYSDATE WHERE comment_id=#{commentId} AND user_id=#{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM community_post_helpful WHERE post_id=#{postId} AND user_id=#{userId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM community_post_helpful WHERE post_id=#{postId} AND user_id=#{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM community_post_helpful WHERE post_id=#{value}

SELECT r.report_id AS "reportId",r.target_type AS "targetType",r.target_id AS "targetId",r.reason AS "reason",r.detail AS "detail",r.status AS "status",u.nickname AS "reporterName",TO_CHAR(r.created_at,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "createdAt",CASE WHEN r.target_type='POST' THEN (SELECT title FROM community_posts WHERE post_id=r.target_id) ELSE (SELECT DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(content,120,1) FROM community_comments WHERE comment_id=r.target_id) END AS "targetSummary" FROM community_reports r JOIN users u ON u.user_id=r.reporter_id ORDER BY CASE r.status WHEN 'PENDING' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,r.created_at DESC

SELECT p.post_id AS "postId",p.title AS "title",DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(p.content,500,1) AS "content",p.medication_name AS "medicationName",u.nickname AS "authorName",TO_CHAR(p.created_at,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "createdAt" FROM community_posts p JOIN users u ON u.user_id=p.user_id WHERE p.category='INFO_REPORT' AND p.review_status='PENDING' AND p.status='VISIBLE' ORDER BY p.created_at
mapper.update: UPDATE community_posts SET review_status=#{status},moderated_by=#{adminId},moderated_at=SYSDATE,updated_at=SYSDATE WHERE post_id=#{postId} AND category='INFO_REPORT' AND review_status='PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT medication_id AS "medicationId",item_name AS "itemName",entp_name AS "entpName" FROM medications WHERE INSTR(LOWER(item_name),LOWER(#{value}))>0 AND ROWNUM<=10 ORDER BY item_name
